source.displayValues: uint8 windowed source; no HU calibration

basis: All 24 current acquired CT sections compared with the same endpoint-registered v17 regional labels; 135 bounded TG candidate entries reviewed, including repeated current frames. Four extra-thoracic vessel targets are outside the acquired heart volume.

clinicalReference.section: ASE/SCA 2013 comprehensive TEE, Table 10 and corresponding view descriptions

statusDefinitions.supported: The intended broad regional anatomy and relation are supported by source inspection; not clinical or leaflet validation.
statusDefinitions.partial: Some defining anatomy or the modeled acquisition approach remains unconfirmed.
statusDefinitions.unsupported: The defining named target is not identified in the available CT; use only as a regional comparison.
statusDefinitions.outside: The target is not included in this isolated-heart acquisition.

globalLimits: Regional labels are approximate tissue ownership, not blood-pool volumes, valve identities or expert ground truth.
The compact shared septum is assigned to LV; only the thin RV-facing layer is assigned to RV. Do not score view identity by the LV/RV tissue ratio.
The 317.6 µm display bank is windowed uint8 source data, not calibrated HU. No source pixels or masks were changed.
The ultrasound examples come from different subjects; CT-versus-cine alignment and probe/esophagus/stomach placement are educational approximations.

me5c.name: Midesophageal five-chamber
me5c.summary: The section includes both atrial and ventricular regions and opens the LV outflow into the aortic root. The fixed LV cavity is narrower than the live ultrasound example.
remainingLimits: Regional continuity is supported; individual valve leaflet identity and clinical beam alignment are not validated.

me4c.name: Midesophageal four-chamber
me4c.summary: Both atrial and ventricular regions cross the section, with the aortic outflow excluded. The large open cavity is RV; the thick, collapsed cavity beside it is LV.
remainingLimits: Fixed-specimen cavity collapse prevents the chamber proportions of a living four-chamber view.
Individual mitral and tricuspid leaflets are not separately segmented.

mecommissural.name: Midesophageal mitral commissural
mecommissural.summary: The section follows the LA–mitral–LV region, with little right-ventricular tissue. The defining mitral commissures and leaflet scallops cannot be confirmed in this CT section.
remainingLimits: Do not identify P3, A2 or P1 from these regional labels.
Some pulmonary-root tissue lies outside the intended left-heart focus.

me2c.name: Midesophageal two-chamber
me2c.summary: A longitudinal LV–LA section is present, with the right ventricle and aortic root largely excluded. The narrow LV lumen reflects the preserved specimen.
remainingLimits: Individual leaflet and LV wall-segment identities are not independently validated.

melax.name: Midesophageal long-axis
melax.summary: The LV, LA and aortic-root pathway are present in a longitudinal section. The LV cavity is collapsed, so its outline differs from the ultrasound reference.
remainingLimits: The coarse regions establish the ventricular–aortic relationship, not individual aortic cusps or mitral scallops.

meavlax.name: Midesophageal aortic valve long-axis
meavlax.summary: The aortic root is cut lengthwise where it joins the LV outflow. Adjacent LV, LA and RV tissue is retained as context.
remainingLimits: Individual aortic cusp identity and a clinical LVOT measurement axis are not established.

meaaolax.name: Midesophageal ascending aorta long-axis
meaaolax.summary: The acquired ascending-aortic segment is cut lengthwise. The neighboring pulmonary root and left atrial region are also visible; the scan does not contain the full arch.
remainingLimits: The available ascending vessel ends within the isolated-heart acquisition.
This section cannot establish the aortic arch branches or complete pulmonary-artery branching.

meaaosax.name: Midesophageal ascending aorta short-axis
meaaosax.summary: An ascending-aortic cross-section is present beside the larger pulmonary-root section. A separate superior vena cava is not confirmed.
remainingLimits: Aortic versus pulmonary tissue ownership supports the main vessel distinction.
SVC and individual pulmonary-artery branch identities remain unconfirmed.

merpv.name: Midesophageal right pulmonary vein
merpv.summary: This is a left-atrial neighborhood section. The named right pulmonary-vein ostia are not identified, so the CT is not a confirmed right pulmonary-vein view.
remainingLimits: No separate pulmonary-vein segmentation or reliable vein-to-atrium ostial continuity is available.
Use the real ultrasound example to learn the named vein view; this CT supplies only nearby anatomy.

meavsax.name: Midesophageal aortic valve short-axis
meavsax.summary: The section crosses the aortic root at a cusp-like short-axis profile, surrounded by atrial and right-ventricular regions.
remainingLimits: Cusp-like morphology is visible, but right, left and noncoronary cusp identities are not validated by these labels.

mervinout.name: Midesophageal RV inflow-outflow
mervinout.summary: The RA and RV inflow region connect to an RV outflow and pulmonary-root region in this section. The aortic root is a central landmark; very little LV-labelled tissue is included.
remainingLimits: The regional right-heart pathway is supported; individual tricuspid and pulmonary leaflets are not separately labelled.
A region-matched CT section does not validate the modeled probe depth or flexion in this donor.

memodbicaval.name: Midesophageal modified bicaval tricuspid valve
memodbicaval.summary: RA, tricuspid-region and RV tissue are present. The superior and inferior caval entries are not both confirmed, so this is a partial comparison to the modified bicaval view.
remainingLimits: Do not infer named caval ostia or tricuspid leaflet identity from the broad regional labels.

bicaval.name: Midesophageal bicaval
bicaval.summary: Both atrial regions are present, but the SVC and IVC openings are not identified together. This CT section is not a confirmed bicaval view.
remainingLimits: The broad atrial correspondence does not prove the named caval entries or fossa ovalis.
The clinical ultrasound example remains the source for the complete bicaval target.

mepv.name: Midesophageal right and left pulmonary veins
mepv.summary: The section samples the left atrial neighborhood. Right and left pulmonary-vein ostia cannot be distinguished reliably, so the named pulmonary-vein view is unconfirmed in CT.
remainingLimits: No separate pulmonary-vein labels or confirmed bilateral ostial continuity are available.

melaa.name: Midesophageal left atrial appendage
melaa.summary: Left atrial tissue is visible, but an appendage with confirmed ostial continuity is not established. This CT section is not a verified LAA view.
remainingLimits: A left-atrial region label alone cannot identify the appendage or its pectinate muscles.

tgbasalsax.name: Transgastric basal short-axis
tgbasalsax.summary: The section crosses the basal LV and mitral region, with the RV beside it. A basal opening is visible, but a complete mitral fish-mouth profile is not confirmed.
remainingLimits: Mitral leaflet boundaries are not separately segmented.
Nearby source sections either enter the aortic root or pass below the intended basal level; this plane is retained as the most defensible regional comparison.

tgpapillary.name: Transgastric midpapillary short-axis
tgpapillary.summary: The LV cavity is narrow and collapsed. The larger open cavity and prominent separated muscular profiles belong to RV; paired LV papillary muscles are not confirmed in this fixed specimen.
remainingLimits: This is a midventricular regional comparison, not a verified paired-LV-papillary view.
The source LV is collapsed. Regional ownership cannot label individual papillary muscles or convert RV profiles into LV anatomy.

tgapicalsax.name: Transgastric apical short-axis
tgapicalsax.summary: This more distal section crosses the LV apex region with an adjacent RV crescent. The LV cavity is almost closed in the preserved specimen.
remainingLimits: The source level is apical relative to the basal and midventricular sections.
Exact clinical wall segments and the beating-heart cavity contour are not independently validated.

tgrvbasal.name: Transgastric RV basal
tgrvbasal.summary: The basal RV and tricuspid region are present beside the shared septal/LV tissue. Aortic and pulmonary-root tissue is also visible, but the complete tricuspid short-axis and RVOT combination is not confirmed.
remainingLimits: A higher RV colour fraction in neighboring sections does not prove the correct tricuspid or RVOT level.
Individual tricuspid leaflets and a continuous RVOT-to-pulmonary-valve axis remain unverified.

tgrvinout.name: Transgastric RV inflow-outflow
tgrvinout.summary: The section contains the RA–RV inflow and the RV outflow/pulmonary-root pathway. It does not substitute an LV-dominant section for the right-heart target.
remainingLimits: The inflow–outflow regional relationship is supported; valve leaflet identities are not separately segmented.
The modeled transgastric probe approach is illustrative, not measured in this donor.

deeptg5c.name: Deep transgastric five-chamber
deeptg5c.summary: The LV outflow and aortic-root pathway are present with four-chamber context. This CT section does not confirm that the modeled deep-transgastric probe can acquire the ideal Doppler-aligned view.
remainingLimits: The physical section has useful anatomy, but the gastric probe route and beam alignment are schematic.
This is not evidence of a patient-specific acoustic window or Doppler alignment.

tg2c.name: Transgastric two-chamber
tg2c.summary: A longitudinal LV–LA section is present with little right-ventricular tissue and no aortic-root section. The collapsed LV lumen is retained as acquired.
remainingLimits: Individual papillary, chordal and leaflet identities are not independently established.
The modeled transgastric approach is illustrative.

tgrvin.name: Transgastric RV inflow
tgrvin.summary: RA and RV tissue surround the inflow pathway. The thick adjacent tissue belongs to the shared septal/LV region, not a second RV cavity.
remainingLimits: The compact septal core is assigned to LV by the regional-label convention; its area is not proof of a wrong right-heart view.
Individual tricuspid leaflets, chordae and papillary muscles are not independently identified.

tglax.name: Transgastric long-axis
tglax.summary: The LV, mitral/LA region and aortic outflow are present in a longitudinal section. The gastric presentation is a modeled orientation of the measured anatomy.
remainingLimits: The regional long-axis relationship is supported; clinical beam alignment and leaflet identity are not validated.

daosax.name: Descending aorta short-axis
daosax.summary: The descending thoracic aorta is outside this isolated-heart CT acquisition. Learn the target from the clinical ultrasound example and schematic probe context.
remainingLimits: No acquired CT plane can verify this target.

daolax.name: Descending aorta long-axis
daolax.summary: The descending thoracic aorta is outside this isolated-heart CT acquisition. The heart reconstruction cannot supply a measured long-axis section of that vessel.
remainingLimits: No acquired CT plane can verify this target.

uearchlax.name: Upper esophageal aortic arch long-axis
uearchlax.summary: The complete aortic arch and its branches are outside this isolated-heart acquisition. The spatial guide is schematic; the ultrasound example supplies the real target view.
remainingLimits: No acquired CT plane can verify this target.

uearchsax.name: Upper esophageal aortic arch short-axis
uearchsax.summary: The aortic arch target is outside this isolated-heart acquisition. A nearby ascending-aortic section must not be presented as the arch short-axis view.
remainingLimits: No acquired CT plane can verify this target.
